verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs make no explicit cold-start latency claims, and community evidence from developers who built comparable systems reports 1-5 second boot times for Cloudflare's Firecracker-based containers/sandboxes, which one commenter explicitly called slow compared to their own ~20-50ms boot times. No official documented sub-second startup benchmark exists, and the only concrete latency figures in evidence contradict the 'sub-second' framing.
